title: Manual of the Driven Pellet
summary: Teaches a Senior to drive the whole pellet mass with qi so a single shot lands like one heavy blow.

title: Course in Close Doorway Fire
summary: Teaches a Senior to clear rooms through doors and frames with qi-driven spreads and a braced guard.

title: Treatise on the Held Charge
summary: Teaches a Senior to keep a charge ready under qi and to release it late for a sudden hard shot.

title: The Swift Shooter's Workbook
summary: Teaches a Warrior to raise and fire and recharge in one flowing rhythm and to shoot while moving.

title: Guide to the Barrel Guard
summary: Teaches a Warrior to parry blades with the barrel and stock and to answer a parry with a shot.

title: Canon of the Walking Volley
summary: Teaches a line of Warriors to advance and fire by ranks and keep a pellet cloud on the foe.

title: Primer of Cover and Scatter
summary: Teaches a Senior to fire from walls and rubble and to time a spread from the edge of cover.

title: The Fowling Piece Disciplines
summary: Teaches a Warrior to stalk and flush and shoot moving foes in the manner of a patient bird hunter.
